$comment: Lighthouse CI config for .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml, which runs on each Netlify deploy preview. The URLs are not listed here: the workflow builds them from its hand-maintained LIGHTHOUSE_PATHS and the preview's base URL. The minScore thresholds are PROVISIONAL, chosen before any real run; reset each one to just below the medians of the first real runs, so existing debt does not fail every run. is-crawlable is skipped because Netlify serves every deploy preview with x-robots-tag: noindex (indexability is enforced by the SEO check over dist/). chat.withotto.app is blocked so Chatwoot never creates contacts in the live sales inbox.
